resources.string: TransitOS does not collect personal data.

TransitOS is an independent, open-source, non-commercial project. It is not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Metrovalencia, FGV (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat Valenciana), or any other public or government entity. It does not represent any official body. All schedule and service data comes from FGV\'s public API (https://www.fgv.es).
Minimum wait minutes between transfers. Less buffer means tighter connections.
